Highlights

Prime 'The Lough' location
Not overlooked front or rear
Walk to UCC & Cork City Centre
Early viewing reccomended

Belmont, 2 Hartland's Road, The Lough Cork T12W6P1

Nestled in a mature and highly sought-after residential neighbourhood, this attractive semi-detached home presents a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, families, and investors alike. There is a private front garden, and well-maintained exterior, the property offers a wonderful blend of comfort, convenience, and potential.

Located in a quiet cul-de-sac leading directly to The Lough, this property offers a rare opportunity to acquire an idyllic family home in one of Cork's landmark residential locations. The house is not overlooked to the front or rear, ensuring excellent privacy, and is accessed through a solid mahogany gated entrance with high boundary walls further enhancing its secluded setting.

The home features bright and spacious living accommodation throughout. The property benefits from excellent natural light, allowing the new owners to create their ideal family home.

The gardens have been thoughtfully designed for low maintenance, with the clever use of coloured gravel and a patio area maximising time for relaxation and leisure pursuits. Situated on a quiet residential street, the property enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining within easy reach of Cork City Centre and a wide range of local amenities.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a home in one of Cork's most established and convenient locations. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.

Location

Ideally positioned on Cork City's highly sought-after southside, this property enjoys an exceptional location within walking distance of many of the city's most popular amenities. The house is just a short stroll from The Lough, one of Cork's most treasured recreational parks, offering scenic walking routes, green open spaces, and a vibrant community atmosphere. Several other parks and leisure facilities are also nearby, providing excellent opportunities for outdoor activities and family enjoyment.

The property is superbly located for education, with University College Cork (UCC) approximately a 10-minute walk or a few minute drive away, while Munster Technological University (MTU) can be reached within a 10-minute drive or approximately 30 minutes on foot. Cork City Centre is also easily accessible, being just a 20-minute walk or 10-minute drive from the property.

Residents benefit from excellent public transport links, with regular bus services providing convenient access throughout Cork City and its surrounding suburbs. The location is further enhanced by its proximity to some of Cork's most established residential and commercial areas, including Douglas, Mahon, Wilton, Ballincollig, and Blackpool.

For sports and leisure enthusiasts, the area offers an outstanding range of facilities within easy reach, including the renowned Mardyke Arena, sports clubs, gyms, swimming pools, tennis clubs, and a variety of recreational amenities. The property is also conveniently located close to Cork University Hospital, The Bons Secours Hospital, Wilton Shopping Centre, excellent primary and secondary schools, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, and local shops.

Combining a peaceful residential setting with unrivalled convenience, excellent transport connections, educational institutions, and sporting facilities, this property represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a home in one of Cork City's most desirable and well-connected locations.
